description:
The unexamined majority. ~79% of AnalyzeActivation evaluations are re-runs
of SURVIVING keys (only ~21% land on abandoned ones), and the campaign has
never classified them. Prior evidence much of it is churn, not ascent: 870
zero-content-change completions on 00420 (recipe: causal stream, fz-kdt.13's
record); 25 of main/0's 83 runs changing nothing; single hot keys needing
>=25 rounds (fn228 take_drop, fn203 predicate); main/0 on predicate: 77
evals for its one key.

## The instrument
Per-key round sequences on the three target fixtures (probe-scale: ~30 lines
of eprintln + stream post-processing -- the fz-kdt.74 cold review produced
comparable tables in an afternoon). Classify every NON-INITIAL evaluation:
(i) GENUINE LATTICE ASCENT -- an output fact's content moved to a strictly
    higher value;
(ii) ZERO-CHANGE RE-RUN -- evaluation concluded with empty changed set;
(iii) REBASE/OSCILLATION churn -- rebased re-runs, and content that moved
    non-monotonically (A->B->A; canon-compare consecutive values where
    cheap).
Attribute each class-(ii)/(iii) eval to its wake cause (the causal replay
already carries this).

## PRE-REGISTERED DECISION RULE (bind ourselves before seeing the numbers)
- If (ii)+(iii) >= 50% of non-initial evaluations: the bottleneck is
  SCHEDULING/CLASSIFICATION (wakes firing on movements that cannot change
  the reader's conclusion) -- the next campaign targets wake precision /
  change classification, and fz-kdt.74's premise (identity churn dominates)
  is answered NEGATIVE.
- If (i) dominates: ascent height is real; the next lever is the WIDENING
  LADDER (fewer, larger monotone steps -- fz-kdt.65's territory), still not
  identity.
Either way the cell model stays refuted (fz-kdt.74's re-entry condition 4
consumes this ticket's answer).

## Acceptance
A per-fixture classification table with recipes, written INTO this ticket
(rewrite, never layer) plus the decision-rule verdict; no production code
changes; probes reverted; tree clean.
title: Ascent census: classify the 79% -- genuine ascent vs zero-change churn vs rebase oscillation
